column2: Ikhawunta ye-Kirana: thengisa, isitoko, i-khata nezincwadi. Mahhala okungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
Isikhundla sanamuhla. Thengisa = imali. Thenga = ukuthenga nezindleko. Amaqembu = amakhasimende esikweletu nabaphakeli.
Amarisidi ezindleko kanye nezikweletu zezivakashi zabahlinzeki (imali ekhishiwe). Ku-akhawunti kuhlala kubhuja yekhasimende noma yabahlinzeki.

I-id yekhasimende noma yomhlinzeki ihlukile (amagama angaphinda). IKhasimende liphethe incwadi yezikweletu (elisikweletayo); Umphakeli usithengisela isitoko (sibakweleta); kokubili kuhle. Ama-ledger ahlala ehlukene; imibiko ikhombisa inethi.
Ibhuku losuku, abakweletwayo nabakweletwayo, ileja yasebhange, amarisidi ezindleko, inzuzo nokulahlekelwa.

Le phrinta ebonakalayo iyithumela kanjani imisebenzi — idokhumenti ye-OS, amabhayithi aluhlaza, noma i-ESC/POS. Okuqukethwe kwe-slip (usayizi wohlobo, ukugoqa, amamajini) kunqunywa ifomethi yebhili / Slip, hhayi lapha.
